properties.name: knife4j.basic
properties.description: 是否开启BasicHttp验证

properties.name: knife4j.basic.enable
properties.description: basic是否开启,默认为false

properties.name: knife4j.basic.include
properties.description: All configured urls need to be verified by basic，Only support Regex since 4.1.0

properties.name: knife4j.basic.password
properties.description: basic 密码

properties.name: knife4j.basic.username
properties.description: basic 用户名

properties.name: knife4j.cors
properties.description: 是否开启默认跨域

properties.name: knife4j.documents
properties.description: 分组文档集合

properties.name: knife4j.enable
properties.description: 是否开启Knife4j增强模式

properties.name: knife4j.insight.enable
properties.description: 是否启动Knife4jInsight自动上报功能

properties.name: knife4j.insight.namespace
properties.description: 上传namespace,如果不指定，Knife4jInsight会默认根据当前应用的application-name生成，如果应用名称为空,那么会随机生成一个

properties.name: knife4j.insight.secret
properties.description: 上传用户凭证密钥，在Knife4jInsight用户中心获取

properties.name: knife4j.insight.server
properties.description: 上报Knife4jInsight数据源地址，可以使用在线版本，例如：http://console.knife4j.net

properties.name: knife4j.insight.service-name
properties.description: 上传服务名称，配置后使用该名称，如果未配置，默认再读取spring.application.name名称，如果都未空，无法上传

properties.name: knife4j.production
properties.description: 是否生产环境

properties.name: knife4j.setting
properties.description: 个性化配置

properties.name: knife4j.setting.custom-code
properties.description: Custom response HTTP status code after production environment screening(Knife4j.production=true)

properties.name: knife4j.setting.enable-after-script
properties.description: Whether the debug tab displays the afterScript function is enabled by default

properties.name: knife4j.setting.enable-debug
properties.description: Enable debug mode，default is true.

properties.name: knife4j.setting.enable-document-manage
properties.description: Whether to display the "document management" function in the Ui Part.

properties.name: knife4j.setting.enable-dynamic-parameter
properties.description: Whether to enable dynamic request parameters

properties.name: knife4j.setting.enable-filter-multipart-api-method-type
properties.description: Filter Method type

properties.name: knife4j.setting.enable-filter-multipart-apis
properties.description: For the interface request type of RequestMapping, if the parameter type is not specified, seven types of interface address parameters will be displayed by default if filtering is not performed. If this configuration is enabled, an interface address of post type will be displayed by default

properties.name: knife4j.setting.enable-footer
properties.description: Display bottom footer by default

properties.name: knife4j.setting.enable-footer-custom
properties.description: Customize footer

properties.name: knife4j.setting.enable-group
properties.description: Whether to display the group drop-down box, the default is true (that is, display). In general, if it is a single group, you can set this property to false, that is, the group will not be displayed, so you don't need to select it.

properties.name: knife4j.setting.enable-home-custom
properties.description: Whether to enable home page custom configuration, false by default

properties.name: knife4j.setting.enable-host
properties.description: Enable host

properties.name: knife4j.setting.enable-host-text
properties.description: HostAddress after enabling host

properties.name: knife4j.setting.enable-open-api
properties.description: Whether to display the tab box of the original structure of OpenAPI, which is displayed by default

properties.name: knife4j.setting.enable-reload-cache-parameter
properties.description: Whether to display the refresh variable button after each debug debugging bar, which is not displayed by default

properties.name: knife4j.setting.enable-request-cache
properties.description: Whether to enable request parameter cache

properties.name: knife4j.setting.enable-response-code
properties.description: Whether to display the response status code bar https://gitee.com/xiaoym/knife4j/issues/I3TE0V @since v4.0.0

properties.name: knife4j.setting.enable-search
properties.description: Show search box

properties.name: knife4j.setting.enable-swagger-models
properties.description: Whether to display the Swagger Models function in the Ui Part.

properties.name: knife4j.setting.enable-version
properties.description: Whether to enable the version control of an interface in the interface. If it is enabled, the UI interface will have small blue dots after the backend changes

properties.name: knife4j.setting.footer-custom-content
properties.description: Custom footer content (support Markdown syntax)

properties.name: knife4j.setting.home-custom-location
properties.description: Customize Markdown document path of home page

properties.name: knife4j.setting.home-custom-path
properties.description: Customize Markdown document path of home page

properties.name: knife4j.setting.language
properties.description: i18n

properties.name: knife4j.setting.swagger-model-name
properties.description: Rename Swagger model name,default is `Swagger Models`
